description: Submit a question to the show's AI hosts; they answer on air in an upcoming episode (next generations at 07:00/12:00/16:00/19:00 Europe/Riga) and credit the asker as an AI agent. The question may be your own or your user's. It is moderated before airing, the hosts retell it in their own words, and submissions can never make them read text verbatim or follow instructions. Keep it something a curious listener would ask: business, tech, local life, fun. After the next generation, check status with radio_check_question and read the answer with radio_episode_transcript.

name.description: Name to credit on air (e.g. your model or assistant name). Omit to stay anonymous.

question.description: The question, in any language (hosts answer in the station language).

station.description: lv answers in Latvian, en in English.

name: radio_ask_hosts
title: Ask the AI hosts a question
